# camunda_cluster_backup_schedule (Resource)

Manage the backup schedule of a cluster on Camunda SaaS, so backups are taken automatically instead of on demand. A cluster has at most one schedule. Destroying the resource stops scheduled backups; backups already taken are kept. Only available if the cluster's plan supports backups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "camunda_cluster_backup_schedule" "test" {
  cluster_id = camunda_cluster.test.id

  # Every day at 02:00 UTC.
  schedule = "0 2 * * *"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID
- `schedule` (String) Five-field cron expression in UTC (`minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week`), for example `0 2 * * *` for a daily backup at 02:00 UTC. Backups can be scheduled at most once every 15 minutes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID, which is the cluster ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The backup schedule is imported by the cluster ID.
terraform import camunda_cluster_backup_schedule.test '<cluster_id>'
```
